Take a medium or large dog that has been at the shelter three months or longer home for a long weekend (pick up Friday, drop off Monday); fill out the Dog Foster Questionnaire and choose "Weekend Warrior". Dog for the Day outings at the Fulton shelter (1251 Fulton Industrial Blvd NW, run by LifeLine) are currently unavailable.
